name: What has to happen before bathroom painting and trim work can actually start?

mainEntity.name: What has to happen before bathroom painting and trim work can actually start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathrooms usually need **special prep** before painting because of moisture, old caulk, soap residue, and small surface flaws. A good contractor will clean, repair, sand, prime, and use paint that holds up better in humid rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathrooms need cleaning, repairs, sanding, caulking, and priming before paint goes on, especially because moisture and residue can ruin adhesion.
